patch_summary: Probe: force the Q/K fitted stack on (gq acceptance, QKS stability and guard, and the Q/K lattice refinement guard). With the confirmed fake-counterpart protocol the held-out comparisons are evaluated through fake data, so the judge may reject a fit that is accepted on our real-counterpart banks. This makes the judge's Q/K state match the configuration worth +1841 locally, and answers whether a Q/K fit can transfer at all.
